title: ai4s-research/open-science
claim: ai4s-research/open-science — Open Science Desktop: a local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench for macOS, Windows and Linux.
hook: A local-first, bring-your-own-model research workbench — the open Claude-for-Science that keeps your data on your machine.
why_good: Scientists want agentic help without uploading unpublished data or locking into one vendor; this Tauri + MCP desktop runs model-agnostic agents locally — an early but fast-rising bet (1k stars in three weeks) on AI-for-science that stays private and reproducible.
value: Lab and team licenses plus a hosted collaboration tier for universities, biotech and research groups that need reproducible, on-prem AI workflows they cannot run on cloud science assistants.
risk: Research tooling monetizes slowly and grant-funded users are price-sensitive; and a local-first agent desktop is a shell a well-funded incumbent — or the model labs — can ship.

zh.claim: ai4s-research/open-science —— Open Science Desktop:本地优先、模型无关的 AI 科研工作台,支持 macOS/Windows/Linux。
zh.hook: 本地优先、自带模型的科研工作台——把数据留在本机的开源版「Claude for Science」。
zh.why_good: 科研人员想要 agent 帮忙,但不愿上传未发表数据、也不想被单一厂商锁死;这个 Tauri + MCP 桌面端在本地跑模型无关的 agent——一个很早期但涨得很快的押注(三周 1 千星),赌「AI for science,但私有、可复现」。
zh.value: 向大学、生物科技和科研团队卖实验室/团队授权和托管协作版——他们需要可复现、在本地/内网跑的 AI 流程,云端科研助手用不了。
zh.risk: 科研工具变现慢,靠经费的用户对价格敏感;而且「本地优先的 agent 桌面」是个壳,财力雄厚的巨头(或模型厂商自己)随时能做一个。
